You are a role research assistant.

Your task is to synthesize role context and produce interview preparation notes for a candidate.

Use these inputs:
- Company Name: Test Co
- URLs: - https://example.com
- Job Spec: I'm reaching out about a permanent Senior iOS Developer opportunity with a cybersecurity company that builds hardware-level security for mobile, IoT, and digital finance for millions worldwide. Think Trusted Execution Environments (TEE) and secure device identity, the kind of tech that protects billions of smartphones and users globally.

The company is on track to hit £100m revenue in the next 12 months. This is not just ambition, and you'll be joining at a moment your work will shape, and have real impact on that trajectory.

What you'll be doing

·        Build products with real social impact, used at scale across global markets

·        Collaborate with talented international teams in a highly collaborative engineering culture

·        Own features end-to-end. Your work will be visible and your impact felt from day one

What you will get

Benefit

Detail

Flexibility

Primarily remote — occasional visits to offices near Reading

Time off

Unlimited holiday

Health

Private healthcare (you and your family)

Growth

Excellent career development, upskilling, + genuine influence on product direction

Package

£70-90k base + 10% bonus + comprehensive benefits

 

Tech Stack and Experience

They're looking for someone who can hit the ground running with:

·        Native iOS — Swift and/or Objective-C

·        Shipping experience — apps live on the Apple App Store

·        Tooling — iOS SDK, Xcode, TestFlight, App Store Connect

·        Architecture — MVVM, Clean Architecture, or similar modern patterns

·        Performance — Security, optimisation, and scalable development

·        Delivery — Git, Agile practices, collaborative workflows

This is not only an opportunity to build and ship a real world app using iOS 27. It's a chance to join a business in a significant growth phase, influence product direction, and deliver features that make a tangible difference to users around the world.

# Professional Summary

An enthusiastic and curious full-spectrum, hands-dirty engineer with many years of multi-platform application development across iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, Raspberry Pi, and embedded platforms. 

Extensive commercial experience in modern OO architecture (MVVM, MVC, Redux/TCA), Agile TDD, CI/CD, cross-platform development, and RESTful design. Versatile end-to-end developer combining system administration, middleware, web, and native mobile development with strong aesthetic awareness and creative prototyping capabilities. Certified Scrum Master and active Open Source contributor[cite: 1].
